title: Chapter 410: The Wu Family Calls For Its Ancestor
content:
Chapter 410: The Wu Family Calls For Its Ancestor

On the other hand, the human race naturally felt this powerful fluctuation.

But the human race obviously has no energy to pay attention to the Heavenly Demon race at this moment.

Because the human race is in trouble now.

The powerful human race now has no rivals in the entire Chaos Realm, but this time the trouble comes from the inside.

"Wu Hui, are you crazy?! This is the Wu family!"

The Man Imperial City, above the Wu Family.

Wu Yutian, the head of the Wu family, pointed at the man in the distance and cursed.

At this time, the Wu family was completely blocked and even a single fly could not fly out.

No matter how the strong men of the Wu family use their methods, it has no effect at all.

And those who can do this are only one of the six powerful clans in the Chaos Realm, the Shadow Clan, which is famous for its way of space.

"And you guys who are crawling inside and outside, when did you become dogs from the Human Emperor Palace?!"

Wu Yutian almost criticized anyone, and continued to point at the Shadow Clan strong men who were still strengthening the space around the Wu family and cursed angrily.

He couldn't understand that since Lu Xue left, these shadow tribes had almost disappeared and could not be found at all, let alone issued orders to them.

But now, these Shadow Clan powerhouses not only appeared in front of him, but also stood on the side of the Human Emperor Palace.

In response to this, the strong man from the Shadow Clan chuckled and said, "Of course, my Shadow Clan is serving the human race."

"I'm not a fucking human race in my Wu family?!"

The Shadow Clan’s powerful man added: “The human race is orthodox.”

"you!"

Wu Yutian clenched his fists tightly and was extremely angry.

Then he looked at the Human Emperor Palace again.

Wu Hui, the head of the Human Emperor Palace, stood proudly in the void, and with his hands in his hands, everything was in control.

"Wu Hui, don't forget, what's your surname? Are you worthy of your conscience and your master when you treat my Wu family so well?"

Hearing this, Wu Hui laughed.

"You actually have the face to mention my master."

"If my master is still here, I know what you do, and I will only do more ruthlessly than me."

"When you meet me, you can burn the incense."

Hearing this, Wu Yutian yelled: "Don't let your mother go!"

Of course he would not admit what the Wu family did, but at the same time he couldn't understand why Wu Hui, who was obedient to their Wu family on weekdays and turned a blind eye to everything he did, suddenly changed his temperament.

He didn't know that from the moment Wu Hui came to power, the idea of overthrowing the Wu family had already been established in his mind.

If the Wu family fails to fall, the human race will inevitably face a situation of division in the future.

As expected, not long after he came to power, the Wu family began to rely on their own influence to buy strong people everywhere and form gangs.

If this continues, the Wu family will really replace the Human Emperor Palace.

At that time, the Human Emperor Palace would be just an empty shell and would no longer have any leadership ability.

As the Lord of the Human Emperor Palace, Wu Hui will never allow such a thing to happen.

"Wu family, you are trying to rebel. Now you are the one who abandons the darkness and turns to the light. But you will not blame me. Everyone is a human race. Please don't go astray!"

In front of the Wu family, Mochou shouted.

At this moment, a large number of powerful humans have gathered around.

Although Wu Yutian, the head of the Wu family, scolded him so badly, the two sides have not completely broken up at this moment.

Everything is just a contradiction and a misunderstanding.

Some of the strong people around them belong to the Wu family and some are loyal to the Human Emperor Palace.

Hearing Mo Chou's words, some of the people present had already begun to shake their hearts.

Seeing this, Wu Yutian looked ugly and quickly spoke, "Everyone, my ancestors of the Wu family were in charge of the Human Emperor Hall in the past, and my Wu family helped them with all their might. If it weren't for my ancestors and my Wu family, how could there be a peaceful and prosperous era of the human race today?"

Wu Yutian directly took Wu Shang, the ancestor of the Wu family.

This is to warn everyone that there are ancestors behind their Wu family.

Moreover, many of them were favored by Wushang, and gradually, many people stood on the side of the Wu family.

Seeing this, Wu Yutian immediately breathed a sigh of relief.

But that's all.

He didn't dare to fight at all.

If it were before, he would have forcibly launched a coup and pulled Wu Hui off the stage. With the strength of their Wu family and the help of so many powerful people, the Human Emperor Palace may not be an opponent.

But now it can't do it.

Why? Lu Xue, the first master of the Human Emperor Palace, is back.

Maybe the one was watching them secretly at this moment.

But when Wu Hui, who was gradually becoming more powerful, was not panicked at all. He walked forward lightly and whispered: "You guys don't even listen to the orders of the Human Emperor Palace?"

"Is the Wu family the orthodox or the Human Emperor's Palace?"

Some old seniors from the Human Emperor Palace pointed to the Wu family and angrily said, "If you guys, if you had no Human Emperor Palace, our human race would have been divided up long ago. How could it be today?"

"If the first and second generation hall masters come back, I will definitely not be able to spare you!"

The first generation second generation hall master!

When hearing the names of these two people, it was obvious that most of the people present were a little panicked.

After all, neither of the two died, they just left.

Who knows when I will come back?

They did this, undoubtedly rebelling.

And at this moment, a sword sound suddenly rang throughout the audience.

Wu Hui suddenly took out a long sword and pointed at the Wu family and said coldly: "Today, we will capture the entire Wu family's senior management and investigate strictly. Those who violate the order will be killed!"

For a moment, there was silence.

Everyone stared at the sword in Wu Hui's hand in a daze, and their bodies were trembling.

Xuanyuan Sword!

The sword of the first palace master is the supreme treasure of the human race.

As soon as the Xuanyuan Sword came out, the scene suddenly fell into a sideways.

At this moment, the Xuanyuan Sword emitted dazzling sword light and buzzed.

Because it has already felt the breath of Lu Xue.

Seeing Xuanyuan Sword's reaction, everyone felt that it must be the first-generation palace master who recognized Wu Hui's behavior, so they strengthened their belief in following.

"Honor, what should I do?"

The Wu family was completely panicked at this moment.

Wu Yutian also had a gray face. The moment he saw Xuanyuan Sword, he knew that he could not win, and at the same time he understood why Wu Hui could mobilize the Shadow Clan.

The first palace master has also come back, what can he win?

However, if he just surrenders, he will be ruined even if he doesn't die. Since that's the case, it's better to fight.

"Wu Hui used his power to seek personal gain and killed innocent people indiscriminately. From then on, he will deprive him of the position of Lord of the Human Emperor Palace. Everyone, follow me and take down Wu Hui!"

"Take off the Wu Xuan!"

Wu Yutian directly charged Wu Hui with false charges. After all, there must be a reason to start a fight.

At this moment, the two sides finally completely broke up and a war broke out.

But at this time, the Wu family had already had a long time to go to the point of being in a desperate situation. The Wu family had no firm beliefs, and when they saw Xuanyuan Sword, they basically turned against each other.

The strong men of the Shadow Clan let go of the passage and allowed the strong men of the Human Emperor Palace to enter the martial family.

The Wu family has completely become a turtle in the jar.

But soon, a large number of surrenders appeared in the Wu family.

Seeing this, Mo Chou continued to shout: "Everyone is a human race, so it is never difficult to surrender!"

Hearing this, more people surrendered to the Wu family.

"Ah!!! Damn it!"

Wu Yutian saw that the situation was hopeless and there was no place to escape. He really hated Wu Hui and the Shadow Clan.

Only the last trump card is left.

"Come, call the ancestor!"
